coordinate_and_tau_policy: reuse each case's sealed original DS1 shared_time winner, selected using randomized TRAIN rows before held evaluation
identity_policy: select each track's hard candidate using randomized TRAIN rows only at the fixed coordinate and tau
mask_authority: receipt-bound prepared_evidence.tracks[].training_mask loaded by reports/2026_09_24_ds1/run.py::make_engine and preserved by reports/2026_09_24_ds1_orbit_arm/run.py::prepare

arms.zero_rate: per-track CFO fitted on TRAIN; every per-NORAD rate fixed to zero
arms.train_rate: iteration-12 conditionally independent regularized per-NORAD scalar rates fitted on TRAIN only within +/-0.25 s/hour; per-track CFO refitted on TRAIN

scoring: cap-800 squared RMS per track, occupied-second weighting within session, equal mean across the six sessions in each case; unsupported TRAIN identities remain at the cap in both arms
held_policy: HELD rows may only score the two already-frozen arms; they cannot select coordinate, tau, identity, CFO, rate, fallback, bound, or stopping
exact_gate: direct SGP4 replay maximum absolute surrogate error <= 0.2 Hz for both arms
launch_policy: write one fixed-point smoke artifact only; do not launch a geographic basin
interpretation: randomized within-track predictive regression evidence, not new-session transfer or untouched validation
